lessons.trigger_condition: The category navigation existed, but selecting a category still left multiple long detail cards visible and did not provide a compact app-like one-feature flow.
lessons.prevention_rule: Keep the home view category-first, show only the selected category function list, expose one allowlisted detail surface at a time, preserve legacy features in category accordions, and keep reset/back navigation deterministic.
validation_required: category selection hides unrelated categories and legacy detail surfaces
function selection exposes exactly one containing detail surface
back and collapse controls restore deterministic category states
bottom dock routes through the allowlisted category and feature mapping
all existing grading, collection and runtime behavior remains available
lessons.safety_boundary: No arbitrary selectors, no source rewrite, no grading or market fact invention, and no claim that CI physically verified the Lenovo tablet.
